prompt: Our neighbour shouted and (to tell / me / to shut) the garden gate.
explanation_ru: В косвенной команде после глагола tell сразу идёт дополнение (me) без предлога to, а затем инфинитив с to (to shut).

prompt: A painter smiled and warned us ___ on the wet bench.
explanation_ru: Отрицательный инфинитив в косвенном предупреждении строится с порядком not to + глагол; частая ошибка — ставить to перед not или переносить don't из прямой речи.

prompt: Priya reached for the soup and (to ask / him / to pass) the bread.
explanation_ru: Косвенная просьба передаётся по модели ask + дополнение (him) + инфинитив с to (to pass), в прошедшем времени asked.

prompt: Marek knew the summer ferry gets full fast, so he (to advise / us / to book) our seats early.
explanation_ru: Когда указано, кому дают совет, после advise используется дополнение (us) и инфинитив с to (to book).

prompt: The office manager told to me to hand the parcel to reception.
answer: The office manager told me to hand the parcel to reception.
accepted_answers: The office manager told me to hand the parcel to reception.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — добавлять предлог to перед дополнением после tell (told to me); правильно: told me to hand.

prompt: Seeing the high water bill, our landlord warned us (not / to let) the kitchen tap run all night.
explanation_ru: После warn + дополнение запрет выражается через not to + инфинитив, причём частица not всегда стоит перед to.

prompt: Rain poured down as we stepped out of the tram in Leeds. Fiona was carrying two heavy bags, so she (to ask / me / to hold) her umbrella while she looked for her keys. A friendly stranger stopped beside us and (to offer / to carry) the smaller bag to the door. Before we went inside, Fiona asked me (I / to live) near the tram stop.
explanation_ru: Просьба строится как ask + объект + to-инфинитив, предложение помощи — offer + to-инфинитив без объекта, а общий вопрос после asked me вводится союзом if/whether со сдвигом времени в Past Simple.

prompt: The shop assistant advised Chidi ___ of the receipt in case the new kettle stopped working.
explanation_ru: После advise с дополнением (Chidi) нужен инфинитив с to; без to или с формой на -ing при наличии объекта получается типичная ошибка.

prompt: Did Dad (to tell / you / to switch) off the kitchen light last night?
explanation_ru: После вспомогательного Did глагол tell остаётся в начальной форме, а команда передаётся конструкцией tell + объект + to-инфинитив.

prompt: The supervisor told the new staff, “Don’t block the fire exit with empty boxes.” → The supervisor ordered the new staff …
answer: The supervisor ordered the new staff not to block the fire exit with empty boxes.
accepted_answers: The supervisor ordered the new staff not to block the fire exit with empty boxes.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное повелительное наклонение Don't block в косвенном приказе после ordered + объект переходит в not to block.

prompt: The classroom felt warm and stuffy after lunch. Elena (to beg / Tariq / to unlock) the tall window behind his desk for some fresh air. Because the handle was high up, Owen stepped over and (to offer / to help) him lift the frame. Everyone cheered as soon as the cool air came in.
explanation_ru: Глагол beg требует дополнения перед инфинитивом с to (begged Tariq to unlock), а после offer инфинитив с to идёт сразу без объекта (offered to help).

prompt: Our tour guide (to advise / everyone / to wear) flat shoes for the walk.
explanation_ru: В косвенном совете после advise с указанием адресата (everyone) используется инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Mateo was about to heat a foil tray in the microwave when Hannah shouted, “Don’t ever put metal inside that machine, or you’ll ruin it!” Which sentence reports her words accurately?
options: Hannah advised Mateo to heat the foil tray in the microwave carefully.
Hannah asked Mateo why he had put metal inside the microwave.
Hannah warned Mateo not to put metal inside the microwave or he would ruin it.
Hannah reminded Mateo that metal had already ruined the microwave before.
explanation_ru: Предупреждение с запретом передаётся через warned + объект + not to put, а will во второй части смещается в would.

prompt: The doctor advised Kenji rest his sore ankle for a week before going back to football.
answer: The doctor advised Kenji to rest his sore ankle for a week before going back to football.
accepted_answers: The doctor advised Kenji to rest his sore ankle for a week before going back to football.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — опускать частицу to перед инфинитивом после advise + объект; правильно: advised Kenji to rest.

prompt: Just before the courier arrived to collect the signed contract, Sofia reminded ___ the postcode on every envelope.
options: to the new intern to confirm
explanation_ru: Глагол remind требует прямого дополнения без предлога to и последующего инфинитива с to; лишнее to перед объектом или герундий — частая ошибка.

prompt: Zainab ran a weekend baking class in a bright community kitchen. As soon as the cakes went in, she (to warn / us / not / to lift) the oven door for thirty minutes because cold air would ruin them. While we waited, she asked me (I / to own) a digital scale at home. At the end, she (to invite / everyone / to share) the warm slices over tea.

blanks.cue: to warn / us / not / to lift

explanation_ru: Запрет строится через warn + объект + not to, общий вопрос — через if/whether + прямой порядок слов в Past Simple, а приглашение — через invite + объект + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Even though Mei wanted to hire the first builder straight away, Piotr (to persuade / her / to compare) both written quotes before signing anything.
explanation_ru: После глагола persuade в прошедшем времени идёт дополнение (her) и инфинитив с частицей to (to compare).

prompt: Rosa emailed Samir and his sister before their weekend stay at her cottage in Cornwall. She (to instruct / them / to collect) the spare keys from the bakery opposite the pier so they would not get locked out. Next, she (to encourage / Samir / to pack) warm coats because the sea wind turned sharp after sunset. Finally, she asked (what time / they / to expect) to reach the village.
explanation_ru: Инструкция и совет после instruct/encourage требуют конструкции «объект + to-инфинитив», а специальный косвенный вопрос строится с прямым порядком слов (they expected) без вспомогательного did.
